meta.side: contingent liabilities (off-budget) — NOT part of the budget total
meta.headline: Gujarat's outstanding guarantees: ₹1,473 cr — 0.74% of revenue receipts; ₹18,527 cr headroom under the ₹20,000 cr ceiling. Outside the on-budget total — the part of the books the budget does not show.
meta.off_budget_note: Finance Dept stated no off-budget borrowings during 2018-23 (narrow self-report). GST back-to-back loans excluded from state debt by GoI fiat: ₹9,222 cr (2020-21), ₹13,040 cr (2021-22), nil (2022-23).
meta.source: CAG State Finances Audit Report, year ended 31 Mar 2023, Govt of Gujarat (Report No. 1 of 2024)
meta.caveat: Contingent liabilities, not budget spending — a charge on the Consolidated Fund only if a guarantee is invoked. NOT part of the on-budget total. Source: CAG SFAR (ex Finance Accounts Statement 20). RBI 'State Finances' guarantees statement = pending cross-check.
